Zero open PRs, one branch, zero Dependabot alerts, no CI.

Keep the unused screenshot derivatives in this repo? Recommended: prune to referenced files plus the two store badges.
Counsel review of privacy and terms before submission? Recommended: yes, and re-check against the shipped build.
